title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Claude Fable 5: Anthropic's new Mythos-class model marks a step-change in AI capabilities, shifting from a tool-like assistant to a collaborative partner capable of complex code optimization and autonomous bug discovery.
Agentic Engineering: The industry is pivoting from direct prompting to 'designing loops' that orchestrate multiple agents, as seen in new platforms from Google and community engineering patterns.
Tesla's Market Shift: Tesla has achieved a historic milestone in South Korea, becoming the first import brand to top the total vehicle sales charts, surpassing domestic giants Hyundai and Kia.
AI-Native Research: Emerging standards like ARA (Agentic Research Assets) propose replacing traditional static papers with executable research packages designed for AI understanding and replication.
2026 World Cup Geopolitics: The tournament faces early diplomatic friction with reported visa issues for star players and symbolic political protests from participating national teams.

items.title: @alexalbert__: Claude Fable 5 Collaborative Intelligence
items.body: Anthropic's Fable 5 launch represents a transition from directive-based AI to collaborative intelligence, demonstrating human-level taste and dimensionality in complex product design and engineering tasks.

items.title: @Google: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate Release
items.body: Google has released Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, a sophisticated speech-to-speech audio model supporting real-time translation across 70+ languages, significantly lowering cross-border communication barriers.

items.title: @VictorTaelin: Fable 5's Recursive Bug-Finding
items.body: Early testing shows Fable 5 can outperform swarms of previous-generation agents in low-level code optimization while autonomously identifying and fixing subtle architectural bugs without specific instructions.

items.title: @Xudong07452910: The Transition to Agent-Readable Research
items.body: A coalition of researchers from Stanford and CMU proposes ARA, a new format for scientific output that packages data, code, and reasoning chains into units optimized for AI agents rather than human-only readers.

items.title: @0xSero: Local LLM Hardware Recommendations
items.body: A comprehensive guide to the current local model landscape, highlighting Gemma 12B and GLM-5.1 as leaders for consumer and enterprise-grade hardware tiers respectively.

items.title: @elonmusk: Tesla Model Y Dominance in Korea
items.body: In a historic shift, the Tesla Model Y has become the best-selling vehicle overall in South Korea, marking the first time an imported car has outperformed domestic models from Hyundai and Kia.

items.title: @WSJ: Apple's Secret Prototype Archive
items.body: To celebrate Apple's 50th anniversary, CEO Tim Cook revealed a restricted archive of five decades of hardware prototypes, showcasing the iterative design history of the company's most iconic devices.

items.title: @433: The €150M Julián Álvarez Market Manipulation
items.body: Reports suggest a strategic collaboration between Real Madrid and Atlético Madrid, where high-profile 'rejected' bids are being used to inflate player valuations and bolster political standings during election cycles.

items.title: @xiaohu: Google Storage and Plus Pricing Pivot
items.body: Google has halved the price of its Plus membership to $4.99 while doubling storage capacity to 400 GB, signaling a more aggressive stance in the cloud services market.

items.title: @icardo8: World Cup Visa Geopolitics
items.body: Political friction reaches the sports world as reports surface of visa complications for Spanish star Lamine Yamal ahead of the World Cup due to past political expressions.

items.title: @xixi_anonymous: Social Advocacy in China
items.body: A significant social movement is gaining momentum in China as young advocates push for raising the legal age of sexual consent to 18, sparking widespread online solidarity.

items.title: @ChShersh: Radical Remote Work Policies
items.body: A new trend in 'extreme remote' work involves mandatory 8-hour paired Zoom sessions with random teammates to combat isolation and maintain high-fidelity collaboration in fully distributed companies.

items.title: @zaobaosg: Japanese Leadership Ties to China
items.body: Political analysts are monitoring potential vulnerabilities for Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi following revelations that her grandson is pursuing studies at a top-tier Chinese university.
